title: Mitha Raaz
style: cinematic film still, shot on ARRI Alexa with a 40mm anamorphic lens, dramatic motivated lighting with a soft rim light, rich warm-and-teal colour grade, fine film grain, shallow depth of field, moody atmosphere, beautiful young Indian people with clear natural light wheatish skin, expressive emotional faces and sharp detailed eyes, vertical 9:16

narrator.look: Riya: Young Indian woman, late 20s, fair skin, long soft wavy dark-brown hair, small bindi, simple pastel kurta. Warm, observant smile.

Aditya.look: Aditya: Young Indian man, late 20s, clean-shaven, sharp features, well-built. Dressed in simple, clean but worn shirt and trousers. Often looks tired or contemplative.

scenes.image: Close-up on Riya's face, a mix of warmth and a hidden knowing expression, as she looks slightly off-camera. She's in her sweet shop, warm lighting.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine kabhi socha na tha, ameer log bhi aise khel khelte hain.
scenes.sub: I never thought rich people also play such games.
scenes.say: मैंने कभी सोचा न था, अमीर लोग भी ऐसे खेल खेलते हैं।

scenes.image: Aditya, dressed simply but neatly, sits on a small bench outside Riya's sweet shop, sipping water from a steel glass. He looks tired but gentle. Riya watches him from the shop entrance.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Roz dopahar mein woh meri dukaan aata tha.
scenes.sub: Every afternoon he would come to my shop.
scenes.say: रोज़ दोपहर में वो मेरी दुकान आता था।

scenes.image: Riya behind the counter, smiling softly at Aditya who is leaning on the counter, engaged in conversation. He has no items to purchase.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Paani peeta, baatein karta, kabhi kuch na leta.
scenes.sub: Drank water, chatted, never took anything much.
scenes.say: पानी पीता, बातें करता, कभी कुछ न लेता।

scenes.image: Close-up on Aditya's eyes as he looks out into the distance, a flicker of sadness or deep thought visible. Riya's hand (out of focus) gestures slightly.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mujhe uski aankhon mein gehra akelapan dikhta tha.
scenes.sub: I saw deep loneliness in his eyes.
scenes.say: मुझे उसकी आँखों में गहरा अकेलापन दिखता था।

scenes.image: Aditya sitting with his head in his hands on the bench, looking genuinely distressed and hungry. Riya is approaching him with a small tiffin box.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Ek din woh bahut pareshaan dikha, shayad bhookha tha.
scenes.sub: One day he looked very troubled, perhaps hungry.
scenes.say: एक दिन वो बहुत परेशान दिखा, शायद भूखा था।

scenes.image: Close-up of Riya's hands opening her tiffin box, revealing warm rotis and sabzi. Aditya looks up at her, surprise and gratitude on his face.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine use apni tiffin se garam roti sabzi di.
scenes.sub: I gave him hot roti and sabzi from my tiffin.
scenes.say: मैंने उसे अपनी टिफिन से गरम रोटी सब्ज़ी दी।

scenes.image: Aditya slowly eating, eyes downcast, a tear escaping. Riya watches him with compassion from a short distance.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Uski aankhon mein shukriya tha, usne dheere se khaya.
scenes.sub: Gratitude was in his eyes, he ate slowly.
scenes.say: उसकी आँखों में शुक्रिया था, उसने धीरे से खाया।

scenes.image: Riya and Aditya sitting together on the bench outside the shop, talking animatedly, hands gesturing, both smiling freely. Dusk lighting.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Humne ghanton baatein ki, apne sapnon par.
scenes.sub: We talked for hours, about our dreams.
scenes.say: हमने घंटों बातें की, अपने सपनों पर।

scenes.image: Close-up on Riya's face as she looks at Aditya (out of frame), a soft, undeniable expression of love dawning on her features.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mujhe usse mohabbat hone lagi thi, uski sadgi se.
scenes.sub: I was falling in love with him, with his simplicity.
scenes.say: मुझे उससे मोहब्बत होने लगी थी, उसकी सादगी से।

scenes.image: Aditya looking directly at Riya, his gaze intense and full of affection, a slight smile on his lips. Riya's hand is visible in the foreground.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Uski nazron mein bhi gehri chahat dikhti thi.
scenes.sub: Deep affection was visible in his gaze too.
scenes.say: उसकी नज़रों में भी गहरी चाहत दिखती थी।

scenes.image: Aditya stands before Riya in her shop, dressed in an expensive suit, looking nervous and somewhat out of place. Riya looks at him, surprised by his attire.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Phir ek din woh badla sa aaya, bahut ghabraya hua.
scenes.sub: Then one day he came, looking changed, very nervous.
scenes.say: फिर एक दिन वो बदला सा आया, बहुत घबराया हुआ।

scenes.image: Aditya's hand gestures apologetically as he speaks to Riya, who is listening intently, a serious expression on her face. The sweet shop items are in the background.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Usne bataya woh ameer hai, sachha pyaar dhundh raha tha.
scenes.sub: He told me he is rich, was looking for true love.
scenes.say: उसने बताया वो अमीर है, सच्चा प्यार ढूँढ रहा था।

scenes.image: Close-up on Riya's face, her expression shifting from surprise to something unreadable – a mix of knowing, sadness, and perhaps a hint of a smile. Her eyes show deep thought.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mere chehre par kayi bhaav badle, uski baatein sunkar.
scenes.sub: Many emotions changed on my face, hearing his words.
scenes.say: मेरे चेहरे पर कई भाव बदले, उसकी बातें सुनकर।

scenes.image: Riya gently puts a hand on Aditya's arm, a soft, knowing smile on her face. Aditya looks utterly shocked, mouth slightly open.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Main muskuraayi aur boli, 'Main yeh sab jaanti thi, Aditya.'
scenes.sub: I smiled and said, 'I knew all this, Aditya.'
scenes.say: मैं मुस्कुराई और बोली, 'मैं यह सब जानती थी, आदित्य।'

scenes.image: Riya looks at Aditya with compassion, a shared history in her eyes. Aditya's shock turns into understanding, then perhaps a bit of guilt.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Mere dada ji tumhare parivaar ke liye kaam karte the.
scenes.sub: My grandfather used to work for your family.
scenes.say: मेरे दादा जी तुम्हारे परिवार के लिए काम करते थे।

scenes.image: Riya stands alone in her shop, looking thoughtfully out at the bustling street, a subtle, reflective expression. Sunbeams filter through the door.
scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.line: Maine chup rehkar uski sachchai ka intezaar kiya. Kya yeh sahi tha?
scenes.sub: I waited silently for his truth. Was this right?
scenes.say: मैंने चुप रहकर उसकी सच्चाई का इंतज़ार किया। क्या यह सही था?

caption: He Pretended To Be Poor, But Her Family Knew His Secret 💔
yt_title: He Pretended To Be Poor, But Her Family Knew His Secret 💔
description: He came to my shop every day, pretending to be poor to find true love. What he didn't know was my family had a secret connection to his. I waited for his truth. Was my silence right?
comment_question: Aap hoti toh usko batati? Haan ya Na?
